articles.title: Wirecard: Wirecard-Boss bleibt in Haft
articles.teaser: Der Ex-Wirecard-Manager Markus Braun ist mit einer Haftbeschwerde gescheitert. Ihm drohen mehr als zehn Jahre im Gefängnis. Nun zieht er vor das Bundesverfassungsgericht.
articles.image_title: Wirecard: BERLIN, GERMANY - NOVEMBER 19: Markus Braun, former CEO of German digital payments processor Wirecard and who is currently in pre-trial custody, prepares to testify in front of the Bundestag commission investigating the Wirecard scandal on November 19, 2020 in Berlin, Germany. Wirecard collapsed after journalists exposed fraudulent accounting that had been going on for years. Braun was arrested and is awaiting trial, while former Wirecard chief operating officer Jan Marsalek is a fugitive. (Photo by Filip Singer - Pool/Getty Images)
